body_html:
• Cut a nori sheet into three strips; trim one strip to fit your onigiri. Keep the nori dry until serving.
  • Place the rough side against the rice. Fold the strip around the base and up the faces to make a grip, leaving rice visible above.
  • Add just before eating for crisp nori. Remove all cling film first.
title: Nori strip

body_html:
• Use half a nori sheet per onigiri as a starting point; trim or overlap to fit the size of your triangle.
  • Put the rough side against the rice. Fold one panel over the front, then the opposite panel over the back; tuck the side corners and overlap the final flap.
  • Press gently with dry fingers. Add just before eating for crisp nori, or let it soften briefly if you prefer. Remove all cling film first.
title: Full nori wrap

body_html:
• Leave the shaped rice unwrapped. Remove all cling film and put it on a clean plate.
  • Handle gently and serve promptly. Keep the nori out of this version.
title: No nori
